ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jan-09-2004 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name.
Commissioner Sue Kaplan, Clerks: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Rhonda Fung.
Due to the clerical error by the Clerk's Office, this matter is advanced and heard on Jan. 9, 2004 at 10:00 a.m. in Dept. 218.
Petitioner Lihn My Phung present in pro per, was sworn and examined.
The Court grants the petition for change of name to: Amy Phung Vuong.
Decree signed in open court.
